subject: Kitbay + PickAPlugin link swap?
text:
Hi,

I like how Kitbay's Official page links the evidence for each vendor claim. Most directories just slap a badge on and move on.

I run PickAPlugin (https://pickaplugin.com), a small free directory of Codex and ChatGPT plugins. We lean toward full plugins and Codex marketplaces, you go much deeper on MCP servers and skills, so the two sit together pretty well. Would you be up for a simple link swap? I'd add Kitbay to our directories page (https://pickaplugin.com/alternatives) and you could link us wherever it fits on yours, maybe a guide page.

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Link swap between plugin directories?
text:
Hi,

Your official MCP servers page is a good idea. Filtering to servers published from a domain the vendor controls cuts out a lot of noise.

I run PickAPlugin (https://pickaplugin.com), a much smaller, hand-sorted directory of Codex and ChatGPT plugins. Would you be open to a link swap? I'd add AI Plugin Index to our directories page (https://pickaplugin.com/alternatives), and you could link us from a guide or related page if it makes sense. Our State of Codex Plugins research is also free to cite with credit if it's ever useful: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Your MCP server directories post
text:
Hi Sushant,

Read your MCP server directories post. The point about listing the product and not just the server is one most of these guides skip.

I run PickAPlugin (https://pickaplugin.com), a free directory of Codex and ChatGPT plugins that also lists MCP servers. Getting listed is free, makers just email us the repo or endpoint, and the listing links back with a normal link. If you add more directories to the post, we'd be glad to be one of them.

Aaron, PickAPlugin
